show.description: Ek Janam aur is an emotional tale of love, betrayal, and second chances. When Esha Chaudhary is betrayed by her closest ones and dies tragically, fate grants her a second life. With memories of her painful past intact, she resolves not to repeat old mistakes - this time, she will live for herself, chase her dreams, and choose freedom over toxic love. As her journey unfolds, she must navigate between destiny, ambition, and the haunting pull of her past relationships.
